# ZPA create-operation documentation drift capture

**Captured:** 2026-07-20

This capture records a narrow discrepancy between the live
`automate.zscaler.com` Docusaurus operation inventory, current Zscaler Help API
pages, and the unauthenticated ZPA management endpoint boundary. It does not
claim that an authenticated create succeeds or that the last captured request
schema is still complete.

## Sources

- [Configuring App Connector Groups Using API](https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/configuring-app-connector-groups-using-api)
- [App Connector Management API](https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/app-connector-management-api)
- [Log Streaming Service (LSS) Configuration](https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/log-streaming-service-lss-configuration)
- [Managing Log Streaming Service Configurations Using API](https://help.zscaler.com/legacy-apis/managing-log-streaming-service-configurations-using-api)
- [Server Group Management](https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/server-group-management) — includes the Private Service Edge Group Management endpoint inventory
- Live Docusaurus blob capture generated by
  `scripts/automate-capture/extract_docusaurus_blobs.py`

## Create operations absent from the live Automate inventory

The 2026-07-20 Docusaurus capture decoded all 1,207 discovered operations. The
following previously captured POST operations were absent even though the Help
API pages still list the same method and path:

| Resource | Method and path | Current Help status | Unauthenticated endpoint probe |
|---|---|---|---|
| App Connector Group | `POST /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/appConnectorGroup` | Documented | `401` with `auth.header.missing` |
| LSS configuration | `POST /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/lssConfig` | Documented | `401` with `auth.header.missing` |
| Private Service Edge Group | `POST /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/serviceEdgeGroup` | Documented | `401` with `auth.header.missing` |

Each probe used customer ID `0`, an empty JSON body, and no authorization
header. The authentication response establishes only that the management
service recognizes and protects the route; it does not validate authorization,
payload fields, or create behavior.

## Documentation-group moves with stable method/path signatures

Several apparent operation removals are route-key moves inside the Automate
documentation tree rather than API removals:

- Provisioning Key Management operations moved from the
  `provisioning-key-management` documentation group to `nonce`; their methods
  and paths are unchanged.
- The App Connector Group list operation moved from
  `app-connector-group-management` to `app-connector-group`.
- The LSS list operation moved from
  `log-streaming-service-lss-configuration` to `siem-config`.
- The Private Service Edge Group list operation moved from
  `private-service-edge-group-management` to `service-edge-group`.
- Enrollment certificate and version-profile list operations similarly moved
  to new documentation groups without changing their method/path signatures.

## Interpretation boundary

Treat the three missing POST entries as **Automate documentation coverage gaps**,
not evidence that the ZPA APIs were removed. Until those operations return to
the compiled Automate inventory, the current capture cannot certify their
request-body required flags. Help, SDK, and provider sources remain independent
evidence for the existence of those create surfaces.
